title: Games to Explore After PAX AUTOCRATICA
description: Compare selected games for PAX AUTOCRATICA readers, with clear reasons to explore each setting and links to independent guides.
intro: These reading routes explore how other games frame planning, scarce resources, and conflict. They are alternatives to research, not verified strategies for PAX AUTOCRATICA.
disclosure: These independent guide websites are maintained by the same operator. Recommendations are editorial suggestions, not official partnerships or endorsements. Official game sources are listed separately.

entries.name: Chronicles: Medieval
entries.reason: Explore a medieval sandbox through battle and campaign questions. It is a useful research route when planning larger conflicts matters more than a single character’s routine.
entries.difference: Chronicles: Medieval centres on a medieval sandbox concerned with battles and campaign decisions; PAX AUTOCRATICA centres on colony management and conflict. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.

entries.name: Ardem
entries.reason: Research crafting, exploration and survival in an outbreak setting. Its source-aware guides are useful for comparing what you carry, where you settle and how you prepare to travel.
entries.difference: Ardem centres on survival, crafting and exploration across an outbreak setting; PAX AUTOCRATICA centres on colony management and conflict. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.

entries.name: Frostrail
entries.reason: Explore how train operation, onboard facilities and expeditions fit together. The guide distinguishes announced core systems from future plans and avoids invented upgrade costs.
entries.difference: Frostrail centres on survival expeditions organised around an expanding train; PAX AUTOCRATICA centres on colony management and conflict. Similar interests do not imply identical mechanics or multiplayer support.
